_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 10 OF 10: SALVAGE RIGHTS.
The plant's regulator is worth more than the plant, and the client holds the salvage rights. Pull it, then get it
out past the rival salvagers who drop in to take it off you. The verb is SALVAGE: the one where the thing you carry
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Salvage: Plant Regulator on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> is a wreck, but its regulator is worth more than everything else in it, and everyone knows it.
prose.card: Salvage contract. We hold the salvage rights to the <Place> on <Planet>. Recover the plant regulator. Others may contest it. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: Whoever was holding the <Place> is dead. The regulator is still in there.
say: That's them? Then the regulator's ours. Pull it, and be quick. We're not the only ones who know it's there.

beats.journal: I pulled the regulator out of the <Place>. It's heavier than it looks and worth more than my ship.
beats.name: Regulator Housing

message.title: Plant Regulator
message.text: The size of a lunchbox and heavier than it has any right to be. A sticker on it reads PROPERTY OF, and nothing after.

beats.journal: I salvaged the regulator from the <Place>, and the people who dropped in to take it off me at the door didn't.
say: You've still got it? With them landing on top of you? Then the rights are ours, and so's the regulator. Bring it home.

broadcast: You're at the site? The regulator's in there somewhere central. We own the rights to it. Other people don't care about rights. Be quick.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
